events.source_name: Noe Valley Merchants and Professionals Association
events.title: Noe Valley Night Market
events.why: Monthly community night market with live music, local food vendors, artists, and handmade treasures in Noe Valley Town Square. Lambert Moss MCs the musical lineup.

events.title: SF Chronicle presents: San Francisco Time Machine with Peter Hartlaub
events.why: Chronicle culture critic Peter Hartlaub raids the paper's photo archive with former Mayor Art Agnos and a Muni archivist, blending Mission District history, the Muni worm logo origin, and Loma Prieta memories at Gray Area.

events.title: BYOB (Bring Your Own Beamer) Pop-Up Projector Show
events.why: One-night exhibit where artists bring their own projectors and take over Gray Area with generative visuals, immersive light, and strange hardware contraptions. Originally conceived by digital art pioneer Rafael Rozendaal.

events.title: Merope w/ Shahzad Ismaily + David Wesley Golightly
events.why: Lithuanian-Belgian duo Merope weave Baltic folk songs, kankles, and kosmische electronics into celestial ambient folk, joined by Oakland composer David Wesley Golightly celebrating his debut solo piano album release.

events.title: Black August Film Screening: The Strike
events.why: Documentary on the Pelican Bay SHU hunger strike paired with a panel on Black August resistance roots, community dinner, wellness sessions, and prisoner letter writing at this deep East Oakland cultural center.

events.title: Ambrose Trataris: Daisy-Chain Star-Connection
events.why: World premiere of a hybrid VR performance blending contemporary dance, drag artistry, 3D world design, and motion capture. Queer worldbuilding that explores embodiment in virtual and physical realities simultaneously.

events.title: Xicana Moratorium Block Party
events.why: Community block party with live music, live art, screen printing, DJs, children's art station, and face painting at the EastSide Cultural Center on International Blvd.

events.price_note: $12 general per program; festival pass available
events.title: CROSSROADS 2026: San Francisco Cinematheque Experimental Film Festival
events.why: The seventeenth edition of Cinematheque's annual avant-garde film festival: 49 works by 52 artists from 22 countries across 8 programs, including JG Thirlwell live-scoring Harry Smith's Heaven and Earth Magic.

events.title: Agentworld x Superdark Factory: Antikythera x Disintegrator
events.why: Philosopher Benjamin Bratton and Marek Poliks deliver a double-lecture on how trillions of AI agents and fully automated agentic systems will reconfigure society. Speculative technology at its most rigorous.

events.title: 2x2: Kevin Corcoran, James Fei, Jacob Felix Heule, Bill Hsu
events.why: Percussion duo and electronics duo improvisations with Bay Area experimentalists, culminating in a quartet. Texture-driven, extended-technique free music from Mills College faculty and longtime collaborators.

events.title: Unseen Visions: A New Age Music and Culture Symposium
events.why: Two-day symposium celebrating New Age music pioneers Robert Rich, Steven Halpern, and Kat Epple with visionary film screenings by Jordan Belson and talks by Erik Davis and Jacob Smith. Esoteric media archaeology at its finest.
